title: ai-agent deployment diagram
description: How ai-agent gets to a developer's machine and runs there. It is not installed with zazzle: the first `zazzle agent llm` or `zazzle agent prompt` makes the invoker exec `zazzle daemon llm`, which downloads the binary for its own release from icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/vX.Y.Z/tools/PLATFORM/ into ~/.zazzle/v1/tools, checks its SHA-256 against the manifest compiled into daemon and execs it. ai-agent then downloads the chosen model from huggingface.co into ~/.zazzle/v1/llm/models, runs it in its own process with llama.cpp (on the GPU through Metal on Apple Silicon) and exits. Nothing stays resident. For an agent's `--llm`, `brief` and `prompt` the zazzle daemon (or `zazzle daemon wrap`) runs `ai-agent prompt --no-download` as a child instead, which fails with exit 4 rather than download a missing model.

sources.symbol: Build, sign and list the JIT tools

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle agent llm ..` to choose a model, `zazzle agent prompt ..` to ask it, and `zazzle ai-agent status|prune ..` to check and tidy the model store.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle agent prompt ..`, often with standard input piped in, as agents/skills/zazzle-agent/SKILL.md says.
nodes.condition: When a coding agent follows the ai-agent-rules skill.

nodes.name: Developer's machine
nodes.description: A Mac (universal binary; Metal on Apple Silicon, the CPU on Intel) or a Linux machine (x86_64 or aarch64, the CPU).

nodes.name: zazzle invoker
nodes.description: Replaces itself with `zazzle daemon llm llm|prompt ARGS` for `zazzle agent llm|prompt`, without contacting the daemon.
nodes.condition: When run as zazzle (or z) with `agent llm`, `agent prompt` or `ai-agent ..`.

nodes.name: zazzle daemon llm
nodes.description: The same process after exec: finds ai-agent beside the daemon or in the tool store, downloading it first, and replaces itself with it.

nodes.name: zazzle daemon serve (or zazzle daemon wrap)
nodes.description: The zazzle daemon, or `zazzle daemon wrap` for `zazzle run --llm`: runs ai-agent as a child for an agent's `--llm`, `brief` and `prompt`, one at a time, killing it after ZAZZLE_LLM_TIMEOUT (src/macos/daemon/.dev/deployment-diagram.json).
nodes.condition: When an agent uses `--llm`, `brief` or `prompt` (or their MCP tools).

nodes.name: ai-agent
nodes.description: Lists or chooses models, or loads one, renders its chat template and streams the answer to the caller's standard output; or reports (`status`) or prunes (`prune`) the model store; exits 0, 1 for an unhealthy status, 2 on errors, 3 when the token limit cut the answer, 4 when --no-download finds the model missing.

nodes.name: Tool store (~/.zazzle/v1/tools)
nodes.description: Downloaded JIT tools, made executable after their hash matched; ZAZZLE_TOOLS_DIR moves it.

nodes.name: Model store (~/.zazzle/v1/llm)
nodes.description: models/ with the installed GGUF files, partial downloads and lock files, and the `defaults` file with the chosen model and effort (0700 directories); ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR moves it.

nodes.name: icelander.net downloads
nodes.description: The R2 bucket behind icelander.net/downloads/zazzle, holding each release's tools under vX.Y.Z/tools/{macos-universal,linux-x86_64,linux-aarch64}/ with their manifest; ZAZZLE_TOOLS_URL replaces it.

nodes.name: huggingface.co
nodes.description: Serves each model file at the repository, commit and file name the catalogue pins (`/REPO/resolve/COMMIT/FILE`).

artifacts.name: ai-agent
artifacts.description: Built by release/tools.sh: universal with lipo on macOS (Metal on the aarch64 half), signed and notarized when configured, one per Linux architecture; listed with its SHA-256 in the tool manifest the release compiles into daemon. Also built with cargo build --release -p ai-agent and put beside the daemon.

artifacts.name: Model file (GGUF)
artifacts.description: One of the ten catalogue entries, a 4-bit (or MXFP4) quantization from 1.3 to 63 GB, accepted only with the size and SHA-256 the catalogue pins.

relationships.description: `zazzle agent llm|prompt ARGS` or `zazzle ai-agent status|prune ARGS`.
exec, keeping the caller's environment, streams and exit status.
HTTPS GET of the tool, once, when it is neither beside the daemon nor in the store.
Stores the verified tool and sets it executable.
`zazzle CMD --llm ..`, `zazzle brief ..`, `zazzle prompt ..` or their MCP tools, through the zazzle socket or `zazzle daemon mcp`.
Spawns `ai-agent prompt --no-download ..` with pipes: the input on standard input, the answer on standard output, the reason on standard error, and the exit code.
Runs as the calling user, one process per command.
HTTPS GET with the platform's trust store, resuming a partial download with a Range request, on first use of a model.

Reads and writes the defaults; downloads under an exclusive flock and renames a model into place when its hash matches; memory-maps it to run under a shared flock; status reads it and prune deletes files under the exclusive flock.
